cards.name: The Flavormancer
cards.oracle_text:
Before the game begins, if The Flavormancer is your commander, legendary creature and planeswalker cards in your deck that are flavorfully Heroes or Villains gain that creature type. (For example, Gideon becomes a Hero and Yawgmoth becomes a Villain. Yes, planeswalkers get creature types this way. Don't worry about it.)
Once during each of your turns, you may cast a Hero or Villain spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: The Local Guides
cards.oracle_text:
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
Whenever another creature you control enters, if the first letter of its name is found in the name of the city you're in, it explores. (Reveal the top card of your library. Put that card into your hand if it's a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on the creature, then put the card back or put it into your graveyard.)

cards.name: Split into Three Parts
cards.oracle_text: Choose target spell or permanent. Exile it with two time counters on it. Create two tokens that are copies of it in exile, with three and four time counters on them, respectively. They all gain suspend.

cards.name: Tarelily, Lovestruck Archer
cards.oracle_text:
Elves and/or Dwarf spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Soulbond (You may pair this creature with another unpaired creature when either enters. They remain paired for as long as you control both of them.)
As long as this creature is paired with another creature, both creatures have reach. If that creature is a Dwarf, both creatures have lifelink.

cards.name: Mysterious Hero
cards.oracle_text:
Super Secret Identity {2}{U} (Before the game begins, if your deck is sleeved, you may put another creature card on top of this one in the sleeve. Don't tell anyone! If this permanent is on the battlefield, you may pay {2}{U} to remove the card above it in the sleeve.)
Hexproof
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.

cards.name: The Swamp Kitten
cards.oracle_text:
Land creatures and/or creatures you control with menace get +1/+1.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, target Swamp you control becomes a 0/0 black land creature and gains menace. It's still a land. Put a +1/+1 counter on it. (It can't be blocked except by two or more creatures. It's dark and scary.)

cards.name: Robby, Another Dwarf
cards.oracle_text: Dwarf creature spells, legendary creature spells, and Equipment spells you cast have squad 2. Tokens created this way aren't legendary. (As an additional cost to cast one of those spells, you may pay {2} any number of times. When that permanent enters, create that many tokens that are copies of it.)

cards.name: Bobby, Another Dwarf
cards.oracle_text:
Dwarf creature cards, legendary creature cards, and Equipment cards in your hand have sneak {2}. (You may cast a spell for its sneak cost if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step. Creatures with sneak enter tapped and attacking.)
When an Equipment you control sneaks in, attach it to a creature you control.

cards.name: The Generational Historian
cards.oracle_text:
Before the game begins, if The Generational Historian is your commander, choose a year. Your deck can contain only cards released in that year. (Legal text, for once, is a great place to check. Specific versions matter.)
Spells released in the chosen year cost {1} less to cast. If the chosen year is in the 1990s, they also cost {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} less to cast, reducing only the amount of colored mana you pay.

cards.name: Wheel of Not Ideal
cards.oracle_text:
Each player discards their hand, passes their library to the player to their left, then draws seven cards. (You draw from your new library, the one passed to you. Please be careful with their cards.)
Flashback {8}{R}{B}

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet's Diary
cards.oracle_text:
Imprint - Whenever a player cards an instant or sorcery spell, exile it as it resolves.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may copy an imprinted card and cast the copy without paying its mana cost. It can't cause you to take extra turns. Then, if there are three or more cards imprinted on this artifact, sacrifice it and create a token that's a copy of Niv-Mizzet, Firemind.

cards.name: Emerin, Shivan Angel
cards.oracle_text:
Angels and Dragons you control have flying, lifelink, ward 2, and "{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
Whenever you sacrifice a Treasure, you gain 2 life.
Whenever Emerin deals combat damage to a player while saddled, create two Treasure tokens.
Saddle 4

cards.name: The Meld Hound
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you cast a creature spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a creature card. It melds with that spell. You may give the combined creature spell a new name. (The combined creature spell has the abilities and creature types of both creatures, their combined powers and toughnesses, and so on.)

cards.name: I'm Going On An Adventure!
cards.oracle_text:
Exile target creature. It's on an adventure. When it enters from being on an adventure, it explores. (Its owner may cast it from exile. To have a creature you control explore, reveal the top card of your library. Put that card into your hand if it's a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on the creature, then put the card back or put it into your graveyard.)
Flashback {4}{W}

cards.name: CGI Fight Sequence
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this enchantment unless you sacrifice a Treasure token.
Whenever you attack, target attacking creature you control fights target creature defending player controls.
